unified.oracle: Every online and persisted Parquet value checked against cyclic integer/rational oracle, including complete unique per-site ranges.

limitations: Read-only inspection uses a catalog/WAL copy capped at 512 MiB and is a point-in-time observation.
Complete native checkpoint validation and resource admission occur at execution, not in compatibility preview.
Upgrade requires exclusive ownership; no in-place downgrade or online schema migration is offered.
A saved artifact without source requires the original source for recompilation.
Exact TradingView equivalence remains a separate stage.
